build_extractor: build a ConvNeXt-based watermark extractor with given config, image size, and number of bits
create_convnext_extractor: create a ConvnextExtractor that detects watermarks as segmentation masks and messages
test_extractor_preprocess: test the Extractor preprocess method that normalizes images to [-1, 1]
test_extractor_postprocess: test the Extractor postprocess method that denormalizes images from [-1, 1] to [0, 1]
review_convnext_extractor_forward: review the ConvnextExtractor forward method that runs preprocessing, encoding, and pixel decoding
